annotations.text: Onboarding is now two steps: connect, then confirm on the watch. Permissions are requested in place when Connect is tapped; privacy is one calm sentence on the first screen.
The 5-second glance: status + live minute, day coverage, recap, follow-ups, conversations. No legends, no counters, no warnings unless something is actually wrong.
Conversations group the tiny transport segments into one card. Interruptions appear inline where they happened - quiet in gray, missing in amber - never as top-of-card warnings.
Ask is a sheet from Today, Library, or a conversation - scoped to what you were looking at. Citations tap through to the exact moment.
Settings root fits one screen. Everything else is a pushed screen; API keys move to Keychain; the retention control becomes real.
